description: This file defines an interface `UploadedFileFactoryInterface` within the namespace `Psr\Http\Message`. It specifies a method `createUploadedFile` that is responsible for creating a new uploaded file object, with parameters for stream, size, error status, filename, and media type.

classes.name: UploadedFileFactoryInterface
classes.description: Interface for creating uploaded file objects in an HTTP message context.

methods.name: createUploadedFile
methods.description: Creates a new uploaded file with specified stream, size, error code, filename, and media type.
